Re: Claim C-1022
Our client: Nancy Johnson
Date of loss: 2024-01-23
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing on behalf of our client regarding injuries sustained in a sideswipe collision that occurred while our client
was changing lanes. Our client was seriously hurt in the incident and is now receiving medical care, and we expect
the insurer to treat this matter with the seriousness it deserves.
Effective immediately, please direct all communication concerning this claim to this office. Our clinet should not be
contacted by you, your adjusters, or any representative of your company. If anyone from your organization has
already reached out to our client, please let us know so we can address it.
We also request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to the
at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming thsoe limits.
Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes the claim file, recorded
statements, photographs, vehicle data, telematics information, dash camera footage, repair estimates, and any other
material in your possession. Please confirm in writing that this preservation request has been received and that the
materials will be retained.
Sincerely,
Sergio Acosta
Gardner & Morris Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
